invariants.rationale: The layer argument is dereferenced multiple times throughout the method, so it must not be null at exit.
If layer.getTextureRegion() is null, the method returns early; if we reach exit, it must be non-null.
layer.getX() is accessed and used in calculations; no side effects.
layer.getParallaxX() is called and should return a consistent value.
Exhaustively, isRepeatX must be either true or false. This is not very deep, but holds by contract (boolean).
